name: Unity Productions Foundation
mission: The mission of Unity Productions Foundation (UPF) is to create peace through the media. UPF produces documentary films for television broadcast, online viewing, and theatrical release and creates long-term educational campaigns to start dialogues among people of different faiths and cultures, especially among Muslims and other faiths.
programs: The Great American Muslim Road Trip

theoryOfChange: UPF creates peace through the media by producing documentary films and educational campaigns to start dialogues among people of different faiths and cultures, empowering citizens with greater understanding and nourishing pluralism.

keyConcerns.headline: Operating reserves are calculated from the FY2023 Form 990, not the FY2025 income statement above

strengths_deep_dive: Unity Productions Foundation maintains stable financial health, operating with <cite id="1">13.1 months of working capital reserves</cite> to ensure long-term sustainability. In FY2025 filings, the organization recorded <cite id="5">$3,570,987 in total revenue</cite> and directed <cite id="5">76.1% of expenses directly to programs</cite>. This performance aligns with industry expectations and is supported by a <cite id="1">fundraising efficiency of $0.22 per $1 raised</cite>. Additionally, the organization holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 97.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, highlighting robust organizational practices and strong institutional transparency.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1999, Unity Productions Foundation uses film, television, and educational media to counter stereotypes about Muslims in North America <cite id="3">through documentary productions</cite>. The organization operates programs such as the MOST Resource Center and educational workshop series to expand dialogue across diverse communities. In FY2025 filings, the charity reported <cite id="5">a total revenue of $3,570,987</cite> while directing <cite id="5">76.1% of its expenses to program activities</cite>. The organization holds a <cite id="1">97.5/100 overall rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong financial accountability and transparent governance practices. At the same time, the charity's reliance on broad reach metrics and capacity-building delivery presents measurement challenges. While the charity reports reaching extensive audiences through broadcasting and educational outreach, direct impact tracking remains focused on output measures rather than independent evaluation.
